findings.summary: The implementation matches the approved bounded-diff contract: it excludes only the active task artifact subtree while retaining source, binary, rename, and unrelated-task changes.
findings.broken_invariant: No invariant is broken; the implementation and regression coverage preserve the required implementation and concurrency-sensitive evidence boundaries.

hidden_assumptions: The task artifact root passed to renderActualDiff is the normalized repository-relative active-task subtree supplied by trusted evaluator preparation code.
